Israeli footballer sent off for gun celebration in Nations League match

Israeli footballer Saied Abu Farchi was sent off during a Nations League match for a goal celebration. He used a corner flag in what was described as a 'gun celebration'. The incident occurred during a match where Israel was defeated by Austria.
